census.method: gate and rail read ONE recipe book (recipes.py); hash-family probe snippets are byte-identical to the determinism gate's — pinned by cross-check test
census.recipe_less_payloads: none — the coverage pin fails the suite on any registered payload without a recipe
census.scope: all 35 proofindex-registered payloads via 28 recipes (23 file-kind, 5 hash-kind covering 12 payloads)

doctrine: A gate without a fix path is friction; a fix path without the gate's recipe book is drift waiting to happen.
The rail regenerates everything in one run; regenerated paths are named with before/after digests.
A recipe that runs clean but produces no payload is a defect — absent-after-write, red, named.
Recipe-less payloads are impossible in the real tree: the coverage pin turns registry drift into a suite failure.

drills.drill: already fresh — the rail is a no-op on honest evidence
stale payload — regenerated, changed paths named
exporter down — a raise is a verdict, never a crash
recipe writes nothing — a defect, named
payload with no recipe — stated; in the real tree the coverage pin fails the suite

rail.seam: run_recipes(recipes, root=..., executor=...) — the executor is INJECTED; the CLI supplies subprocesses, demos supply fixtures
